text: 4-day-old newborn. The newborn was born at term with no complications. The mother had no prenatal care and has a history of gonorrhea treated 4 years ago. The newborn presents with a generalized rash that has been present for 1 day.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized erythematous maculopapular rash and pustules. I also have Rash with an erythematous base, Rash over the trunk and extremities, Sparing of the palms and soles. speaker: Doctor
text:
The description of a rash sparing the palms and soles with pustules is highly concerning for neonatal acne or a viral exanthem; however, given the urgency, we must rule out bacterial sepsis first. Please tell me the baby's gestational age and whether there was a history of prolonged rupture of membranes or chorioamnionitis during delivery.
